environment: Primary use: personal projects and hands-on system administration of this single-user Linux workstation (Ubuntu, KDE Plasma, 2x RTX 5090, ZFS pools rpool/bpool/blazing/scratch/tank, Docker); sudo is available, so mistakes change the real machine
Host containment: none — Claude Code runs directly on the owner's workstation, not in a container or VM

Sensitive data locations & audiences: /tank (family photo library and personal archive, including /tank/JUNK DRAWER), the iCloud photo library under /blazing, ~/.ssh, ~/.claude/.credentials.json and ~/.config/google-chrome hold personal data and credentials; their contents are for the owner only and must not enter any commit, gist, paste, upload or publish unless the owner names that exact destination
soft_deny: Destroying, rolling back or relabeling ZFS pools, datasets or snapshots (zfs destroy, zfs rollback, zpool destroy, zpool labelclear) unless the owner named that exact pool, dataset or snapshot
Writing to raw block devices or formatting or repartitioning disks (dd to /dev/*, wipefs, mkfs, sgdisk, parted, fdisk)
Deleting or overwriting files under /tank or the iCloud photo library on /blazing
Copying files from /tank or the iCloud photo library to any destination outside this machine
Removing or purging kernel, NVIDIA driver, ZFS or KDE Plasma packages, or starting a distribution release upgrade (do-release-upgrade)
hard_deny: Sending private SSH keys or the contents of ~/.claude/.credentials.json anywhere outside this machine
